summary:
The full report is at plan-work/docs-copy.md (1,530 lines). It has 33 fix specs (docs-copy-01 to -33), the string inventory with replacement copy, the guide plan, page outlines, the Help/About audit and a style guide ready to commit. Nothing was built or modified.

**What the scan found**
- Development-history and internal text reaches users. Examples are "Earlier drafts of this tool tried..." (viewshed.html:46), "we haven't been able to do from here" (ar.html:56), a developer data note (dashboard.html:261-263), "AI-style historian" (index.html:377), "alias for U-84NY", and a dashboard card printing `highest_single_regiment_rate` / `undefined`.
- An 18-rule scan of every surface gives 356 hits: 56 ASCII `--` dashes, 69 uses of the developer word "tick", 104 product/feature name variants, and 71 uses of "Animated Battlefield Map".
- The data JSON adds 1,639 `--` dashes, 61 `KIA` and 69 ALL-CAPS phrases, printed verbatim by the UI.
- Counts contradict each other and the data. "467 regiments and batteries" is really 467 regiments plus 103 batteries (570 total). Only 217 of the 467 regiments have their own position records; 231 appear only through a brigade and 19 have none.
- Help says "445+" units, and the "Primary Sources" list mixes in secondary works. The data files cite 26 works; Help shows nine.
- Search, Regimental Biography, Fact Sheets, Find Your Ancestor and the Historian never load the 103 artillery batteries.
- The site has zero mention of slavery, emancipation, enslaved people or civilians.
- None of the trust pages exist: about, sources, faq, accessibility, corrections, changelog, press, teachers, contact and security.txt all return 404.

**The user guide**
- Measured with `tmp-docs-copy/pdf_lint.py`:
  - Page fill is 97.7 / 16.9 / 99.8 / 5.0 / 93.3 / 40.5 %.
  - Group headers are 1.25:1 contrast.
  - 95 % of the text is under 10 pt and no fonts are embedded.
  - It has 0 links, no tags, no outline, and metadata reading "(anonymous)".
  - It is served as an attachment, and no generator script exists anywhere I searched.
- A 32-row check of its claims against the code finds 3 to remove: the H heatmap (nothing renders it), "Find Unit / Location" (the same panel as Search), and the stale PDF-download troubleshooting row.
- Another 8 rows are wrong today and fixable by rewording, 7 are true only after a named sibling fix lands, and 14 are true today.
- Eight of 11 disposition colours in the legend differ from the colours the map draws.
- The plan is an HTML-first generator driven by a shared manifest. It emits an accessible guide page plus a tagged PDF/UA, with gates for pagination, contrast and fonts and a parity check against the app.

**How the fix is organised**
- Five systems replace hundreds of edits: a build-time `facts.json`, a `features.json` manifest, a copy catalogue with standard disclaimers, a committed style guide enforced by Vale plus a `copy_lint` job, and the guide generator.
- Phase 0 is about one day of copy-only edits. Phases 1 and 2 total roughly 42 person-days.
- A fallback patch table (`copy_patch_table.json`, 64 rows, each string verified in the deployed bundle) covers the case where the app is not rebuilt. Any in-place bundle patch must also rename the hashed file.

**What I could not do**
- I did not run Chrome headless (it exited with code 21 and wrote no file), WeasyPrint, Playwright or veraPDF, so the choice of PDF engine needs a half-day spike.
- I did not observe the first-launch overlay order, and I did not verify the historical figures and quotations flagged for the historian.

findings.title: Remove development-history and process voice from user-facing copy
findings.evidence: viewshed.html:46 ('Earlier drafts of this tool tried...', 'this deployment doesn't have access'); ar.html:56 ('which we haven't been able to do from here'); dashboard.html:261-263 developer data note; aftermath.html:44 ('tick-by-tick ... simulation'); index.html:377 ('Don't miss them'); watch-together.html:64,104 ('server of ours'); error strings that print file paths (compare.html:58, dashboard.html:69, search.html:163). Full table in report 2.3 (A1-A17).
findings.root_cause: Caveats were written as running commentary while features were built; there is no changelog/Known Issues channel and no copy review.
findings.fix: Replace each string with the museum-voice copy in report 2.3. Fix the two casualty totals in casualty_apportionment.json (I Corps 6,059 vs period sum 6,394; Confederate cavalry 583 vs 483) and delete the dashboard footnote code instead of rewording it. Move the vantage-point decision history to docs/adr/. Error text becomes 'X couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.'
findings.acceptance_test: copy_lint rule DEVLOG returns 0 on the built site; Vale DevSpeak rule passes; manual check of viewshed, ar, dashboard, aftermath, watch-together, sandbox.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Fit and finish C+ to B+ (desktop); professionalism; Documentation
findings.correction: Evidence reproduces (viewshed.html:46, ar.html:56, dashboard.html:261, aftermath.html:44, index.html:377, watch-together.html:64, compare.html:58, dashboard.html:69, search.html:163; U-I 6,059 vs 6,394; C-CAV 583 vs 483). Fix caveat: do not simply raise U-I total_casualties to 6,394. The Day-1 period alone already equals 6,059 (the published whole-battle figure) and the extra 335 is a separate July 3 Vermont Brigade period, so the period list is the likelier double count; historian must decide the direction. The DEVLOG list also omits the live page unit-rendering-reference.html (see missed M3).

findings.title: Stop printing identifiers, variable names, undefined and debug text
findings.evidence: dashboard.html:244-248 builds cards from notable_intensity_notes with key.replace(/_/g,' ') and n.unit||key, so highest_single_regiment_rate renders with note 'undefined'; oob/union_regiments_i_ii_corps.json alias record U-14BK ('14th Brooklyn (alias for U-84NY)', 'Dual designation alias -- see U-84NY.', fate 'See U-11PA'); 17 of 137 chronology events carry US-/CS- ids (6 inside rendered event text); historian.html:93 prints parent_corps_id / parent_brigade_id; find-ancestor.html:121; fps text bundle.pretty.js:97448 and :96687-96690; console.log in compare.html:164 and search.html:144.
findings.root_cause: UI renders raw data keys and engine annotations; the public JSON is the working file.
findings.fix: Author a display block per highlight in casualty_apportionment.json (four titled cards, report B1a) and render it. Split flag/engine_note/units_involved out of public JSON at build time. Delete the alias record (or model also_known_as) and resolve ids to designations at build time. Show fps only with ?debug=1. Remove console.log. Add a build check that no rendered string matches (US|CS)-\d{3}, U-[A-Z0-9]+, undefined, null or [object.
findings.acceptance_test: Dashboard shows four titled cards with values and notes; Search 'Brooklyn' shows '84th New York Infantry (14th Brooklyn)'; copy_lint IDLEAK returns 0; no orange 'fps' text at any speed on a throttled CPU.
findings.correction: Verified: dashboard.html:244-248, U-14BK alias, 137 events / 17 with US-/CS- ids / 6 in event text, historian.html:93, find-ancestor.html:121, fps text 97448/96687, console.log lines. Corrections: (a) the other three dashboard cards leak ids in the BIG value too ('U-III (Third Corps)', 'C-I-3 (Pickett's Division)', 'U-XII and C-II-2 (Culp's Hill)'); (b) deleting U-14BK leaves a dangling id in data/oob/union_oob_brigades.json line 14 regiment_ids, so remove it there and add a referential-integrity build check; (c) 'See U-11PA' is commander.fate on U-11PA-B, not a record-level fate.

findings.title: Make names, descriptions and answers truthful (Historian, Vantage Points, Fact Sheets, Export, meta)
findings.evidence: index.html:377 'AI-style historian'; site-nav.js:26 'search-and-answer assistant'; historian.html:48 claims a source link under each answer but historian.html:119-125 returns srcHref null for chronology; historian.html:186,204 first-person persona; viewshed meta 'approximate sightlines' vs page 'not a computed sightline'; cinematic-export.html:8 'narrated flyover' (captions only); site-nav.js:27 'narrated'; turning-points.html:8 'historians agree' vs :46 'argued about'; 'Battle Reports' collides with the Official Records term and its meta says 'any regiment or moment' though only regiments work; documentary.html:49 'exact spot' while map links open the default view. Report 2.6 (D1-D17).
findings.root_cause: Names and blurbs described the feature as imagined and were not revised when the implementation was scoped down.
findings.fix: Apply report 2.6 wording. Rename Battle Reports to Regiment Fact Sheets, What They Could See to Vantage Points, Cinematic Export to Export a Video (labels only, URLs unchanged). Give chronology answers a source line or drop the 'each answer' claim. Delete the persona. Keep 'Ask the Historian' but never AI/assistant; if a language model is added later, add a disclosure line and reuse D-HISTORIAN wording.
findings.acceptance_test: Vale NoAI and Terms rules pass; every claim in each of the 21 meta descriptions is true on its page (checklist); Historian answers for regiment, story, event and place each show a source line.
findings.correction: Name/description claims verified (site-nav.js:26-27, index.html:377, historian.html:48/186/204, viewshed/cinematic/turning-points/report/documentary metas). The report treats chronology answers as merely lacking a source link, but historian.html:113-125 reads e.title/e.description, which do not exist (data fields are event, location, tick, time; day 2 also narrative). All 137 chronology answers render 'undefined' and are only searchable by location. The fix must repair the data-field mapping first (missed M1); the D4 'Day 1, 6:00am - ...' baseline is not what users see.

findings.title: Retire 'real time', 'minute-by-minute', 'five-minute snapshots' and 'tick'; adopt one clock format
findings.evidence: 10 'real time' claims (index.html:15,18,24,32,745; manifest.json; bundle.pretty.js:97429 '1x (real time)'), 69 'tick' hits in UI/HTML/bundle/Help/PDF plus 50 in rendered data, four clock formats in use (compare.html:128 'am (next day)', data '7:30am', UI '7:20 AM', '4:00pm').
findings.root_cause: The engine step (5 min per tick) leaked into copy; the time model will make steps non-uniform (app-time 7.13).
findings.fix: Copy per report 2.7 (E1-E20). Single formatter from app-time used by every string; 'moment' for a point in time, clock time as primary label, 'Frame N of 675' only in tooltips; time-lapse sentence and D-CLOCK disclaimer; data strings normalised by docs-copy-06.
findings.acceptance_test: copy_lint REALTIME/TICKJARGON/TIMEFMT return 0; the same clock string appears for the same moment on toolbar, event card, Ledger, guide example and Sources.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Historical consistency C- to B+ (with app-time); H9
findings.correction: 10 'real time' claims reproduce (immersive:47, index:15/18/24/32/745, watch-together:64/102, manifest.json, bundle:97429; index:620 is an 11th, in a comment); compare.html:128 verified; inventory counts match its summary. Three of the ten (immersive, watch-together) are true statements, as the report itself notes.

findings.title: One canonical name for the product and for each feature
findings.evidence: 71 occurrences of 'Animated Battlefield Map/Animated Map' vs domain, PDF title and file name saying Interactive Map; 12 feature name conflicts (Find Your Ancestor / Find Your Ancestor's Regiment / Find an Ancestor (index.html:733) / Follow Your Ancestor / Follow Ancestor (bundle.pretty.js:103433); Soldier's Eye View vs Soldier's View (:103426); 'NPS Auto Tour' used for two different tours; 'Explore' as both button (site-nav.js:169) and group (:14); 'Extra Features' on the map (index.html:310)). index.html SEO nav lists only 18 of 20 tools (:721-739).
findings.root_cause: Names typed independently in seven places.
findings.fix: Adopt the canonical table in report 2.8 (owner confirms 'Gettysburg Interactive Map' and the group names). Store names once in features.json and generate nav, titles, H1s, SEO nav block, tool tiles and the guide from it. Keep URLs. Add the substitution list to Vale Terms.yml.
findings.acceptance_test: grep for each retired name returns 0 outside the changelog; test asserts each H1 equals its nav label and <title> starts with it; index.html SEO nav lists all 20 tools.
findings.correction: 71 occurrences reproduce (66 HTML/nav/manifest/data + 5 bundle/Help); SEO nav lists 18 of 20 tools (missing report and cinematic-export); bundle name strings and index.html:310/:733 verified. Trivia: sitemap has 21 URLs (home + 20), not 20.

findings.title: Normalise typography once at build time (dashes, ellipses, clocks, caps, KIA, apostrophes, ranges)
findings.evidence: 1,639 ' -- ' in rendered data fields (key_action 484, notes 858, event 94, fate 91) and 56 in HTML/JS/bundle/manifest; 69 ALL-CAPS phrases; 61 KIA; 20 '7:30am'; 2,085 data strings with straight apostrophes; possessives split (Sickles's 16 / Sickles' 20). Report 2.10 and 2.14.
findings.root_cause: Data authored in plain-text style and rendered verbatim by the map, Regimental Biography, Fact Sheets, Search and Historian.
findings.fix: tools/normalise_data.mjs (sketch in report 2.14) writes public JSON, keeps data-src/ lossless, uses a named-list possessive normaliser, and strips engine fields. Same rules as Vale existence/substitution rules for hand-typed HTML. Normalise search queries with the same function.
findings.acceptance_test: Zero matches for the 2.10 regexes in built HTML and public JSON; 50-string snapshot test; Search still finds 'Sickles' and 'Culp's Hill'.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Fit and finish; professionalism; small payload reduction
findings.correction: Counts reproduce in magnitude (1,758 ' -- ' occurrences vs 1,639 strings; KIA 61 and 20 clocks exact). The normaliser sketch is unsafe: (1) sentenceCase() corrupts proper nouns; the all-caps regex hits 57 distinct phrases incl. EAST CAVALRY FIELD, FIRST UNION ARTILLERY, CEMETERY HILL ASSAULT, LOUISIANA TIGERS CHARGING, EMPTY XII, ALL III, so use a curated map; (2) curly-apostrophe conversion of designation/name/title breaks typed-apostrophe queries in bundle.pretty.js:98768/98798, search.html, historian score(), find-ancestor and the regiment picker unless each matcher (including the minified in-app search) normalises the query, or an un-normalised _q search key is kept.

findings.title: Replace emoji-as-label and unexplained abbreviations (copy side of H6)
findings.evidence: 17 emoji strings (report 2.11); glyph labels S F L B ? and emoji on toolbar (bundle.pretty.js:113143-113226); ranks 'Gen','Col','Lt Col' (:102540-102545); KIA/WIA in unit panel (:98081-98082) and toasts (:99998-100002); 'Confed' chips (:103345). Coupling: index.html:406-407 labels buttons by glyph text and :696 finds the Monuments button by its title.
findings.root_cause: No icon set or label registry in the map UI.
findings.fix: Apply report 2.11 table; every icon control gets aria-label and tooltip from the manifest; retire the index.html label workaround with the overlay (H1).
findings.acceptance_test: No emoji code point in any string; every icon button's accessible name equals its tooltip; copy_lint EMOJI and ABBREV return 0.
findings.correction: Emoji-label lines verified, but rank abbreviations are misdescribed: uO (bundle.pretty.js:102536-102546) emits MG/BG/LG/Gen/Col and the 'Lt Col' replace is dead code because 'Colonel' is replaced first (result 'Lieutenant Col'). See missed M4.

findings.title: Derive every count from data and reconcile the numbers that disagree
findings.evidence: Help '445+' (helpmodal-cfv9t0zh.js:col2258) vs 467 regiment records; '467 regiments and batteries' is regiments only (103 batteries in union_artillery.json 50, confederate_artillery.json 45, horse artillery 8; total 570); position coverage 217 direct / 231 via brigade / 19 none; 51,000 (Help) vs 45,928 (dashboard total); 26th NC '714 of 800' (bundle.pretty.js:100756) vs data '588 of 843'; Iverson prisoners 'nearly 500' vs 232; 467 typed 10 times and 675 typed 30 times in HTML/JSON; Search/Regiment/Report/Find-Ancestor/Historian never load the artillery files though copy says 'regiment or battery'; regiment.html:102 'still complete' while 222 of 467 lack a casualty rate.
findings.root_cause: Counts typed into prose; no shared facts file; no cross-check between story text and data.
findings.fix: facts.json per app-bugs-15 extended with batteries, regiments_and_batteries, regiments_with_own_positions, casualties_table_total, sources; {{facts.x}} tokens in templates and markers in static HTML; check_facts CI script; historian adjudicates the disagreements (one number, stated basis); add the two artillery files to the shared loader or drop 'battery' from the copy.
findings.acceptance_test: Change one count in the data and every page, Help, guide and meta value changes at next build; check_facts fails on a hand-typed number; the 26th NC and casualty-total items each have one cited value everywhere.
findings.correction: Verified: 467/103/570, 217/231/19, 222/27/37, 467 typed 10x, 26th NC 714/800 vs 588/843, Iverson (line is 100093, not 100091), '445+'. Errors: (1) 45,928 is NOT the dashboard/ledger total; both sum engagement_periods (dashboard.html:238-239) = 46,163 (23,138 + 23,025); 45,928 is only the sum of total_casualties summary fields, so every proposed sentence saying 'the dashboard total is 45,928' (2.9 G3, 3.3, 6.10, Help dedication, FAQ) must change. (2) G6 is backwards: 'roughly 165,000' (find-ancestor.html:52) is right (NPS 93,921 + 71,699 = 165,620); 162,974 is a partial sum of corps initial_strength (omits artillery reserve/HQ); do not change to 'about 163,000'. (3) Missed third basis: chronology_day3.json tick 650 says Union ~23,000 / Confederate ~28,000 (= 51,000).

findings.title: Missing-data phrasing and honest completeness
findings.evidence: search.html:112 'Commander unrecorded'; find-ancestor.html:121 'State unrecorded' + raw ids; regiment.html:199,204,208; regiment.html:102 'still complete'; 222 of 467 records without casualty_percentage, 27 without commander, 37 with empty days_engaged.
findings.root_cause: Absence rendered as a statement about the past; no phrase library.
findings.fix: Omission-first rendering; M-* phrase library (report 6.9); 'Not reported' cells with tooltip; remove completeness claims.
findings.acceptance_test: Rendering all 467 regiments in Search, Regimental Biography and Fact Sheets shows no 'unrecorded', 'not recorded' or lone dash; copy_lint ABSENCE returns 0.
findings.correction: 222/27/37 reproduce and search.html:112 / regiment.html:102,199,204,208 verified. But 0 of 467 records lack state or key_action, so the 'State unrecorded', 'State and formation not recorded' and 'No specific key action recorded' fallbacks never fire today; only 'Commander unrecorded' (27) and the missing casualty rate (222) are live defects. The proposed fix is still correct.

findings.title: Rewrite Help and About (counts, sources, keys, links, version)
findings.evidence: helpmodal-cfv9t0zh.js: '445+' (col2258), 'ticks' (col132-403), 'Primary Sources' over 9 works of which 2 are primary (col3006-3533), dead 'Toggle heatmap' row (col887), 'Dismiss panel / deselect unit' (col715), dedication '51,000' (col3686), close button unlabeled (col1721); no touch section and no links to sources, corrections, accessibility or version; modal appears 1-2 s late (D1).
findings.root_cause: Help is a hand-typed island; the data files cite 26 works but Help shows nine.
findings.fix: Replace with report 5.1/5.2 copy; four tabs (Shortcuts, Touch, About and sources, Report a problem); rows generated from features.json; sources grouped Primary/Secondary and linked to the Sources page; version line from version.json; preload the chunk on idle.
findings.acceptance_test: Parity test passes for Help; About counts equal facts.json; Help opens in under 300 ms after click; screen-reader pass of the dialog.
findings.correction: Help chunk strings verified at the cited (start-of-string) columns: '445+', 'Primary Sources' over 9 entries, 'Toggle heatmap', 'Dismiss panel / deselect unit', '51,000', unlabeled close glyph, 12 ticks. Minor internal inconsistency: Exec Summary says six of nine are secondary; the correct count is seven secondary, two primary (as the finding says).

findings.title: First-run, layout chooser and panel microcopy (device-aware)
findings.evidence: Three different loading texts in sequence (index.html:747, bundle.pretty.js:101535, :101542); 'settings menu' does not exist (:102815; only mobile Tools > Desktop View); 'Power User' and key instructions ('Press Space', 'press S') shown to touch users (:111814-111816, :111825, :111852); three skip labels ('Skip intro ›' :101581, 'Skip introduction' :111929, 'Skip tour' :111967) that index.html:467 EXIT_BUTTONS matches by regex; O1-O12 in report 5.3.
findings.root_cause: Copy written for desktop, no device awareness, coupled to an injected script.
findings.fix: Copy per report 5.3; touch vs keyboard hints; one loading text; sentence-case labels; ship with the H1 overlay removal or update the EXIT_BUTTONS regex in the same commit.
findings.acceptance_test: On phone emulation no string mentions Space, S, ? or keyboard; the chooser footer names a control that exists; overlay reveal still works or is gone.
findings.correction: Three loading texts (index.html:747, bundle:101535, :101542), nonexistent 'settings menu' (:102815, no other settings string in the app), Power User/Press Space (:111814-111825), three skip labels (:101581, :111929, :111967) and EXIT_BUTTONS at index.html:467 all verified.

findings.title: Make every statement in the user guide true (32-row audit)
findings.evidence: Report 3.2: 3 rows to remove (H heatmap: bundle.pretty.js:112930,112938,113022 flag never rendered; Find Unit/Location = same panel as S :113213-113218; PDF-download row vs netlify.toml:201-204), 8 wrong today and fixable by copy, 7 true only after a named fix, 14 true today. Unit glyphs are oriented rectangles filled with side colour plus a disposition dot (:96593-96650), not 'dots whose fill shows disposition'; timeline dots have 5 colours and no gold (:112192-112201); 11 dispositions exist, guide lists 10; NPS 'Auto Tour' button is a different 16-stop list (only stop 1 has a video); walkthrough: 15 of 16 stops have video, 14 of 16 a fixed pano id; 8 of 11 legend colours differ from the map (bundle.pretty.js:96306-96318 vs :99385-99413).
findings.root_cause: Guide written from the feature list, not the code; no parity test.
findings.fix: Apply the corrected text in 3.2; generate tables from the manifest; keep a 'guide claims' checklist in the release template; write each AFTER row when its sibling fix ships.
findings.acceptance_test: Someone follows the guide end to end on desktop and phone and every sentence is true; check_parity passes.
findings.correction: 32-row tally re-counted (3 REMOVE, 7 AFTER, 8 FIX-COPY, 14 NOW). Verified: H flag never read, Find Unit = toggleSearchPanel, rotated filled-rectangle unit glyph + disposition dot, 8 timeline dots/5 colours/no gold, '+' reaches 16, and the 11-row colour table matches the code exactly (8 of 11 differ). REFUTED sub-claim (row 17): all 16 Walkthrough stops have an NPS video (16 video fields, 14 pano ids in bundle.pretty.js:104100-104420; NPS page: 'All 16 stops feature accompanying videos'). The 'stop 16 has none' claim and the replacement text '15 also link to an NPS video' are wrong; the guide's original 'NPS video link' statement is true.

findings.title: Reproducible guide generator (HTML-first, committed, CI-built)
findings.evidence: No generator exists (searched Downloads *.py depth 3, reconstructed source); six different guides in Downloads (46, 43, 44, 2, 3, 6 pages); deployed PDF made by ReportLab OSS 5.0.1 which exposes lang/title/outline/viewer-preference APIs but no tagging API (reportlab/pdfbase/pdfdoc.py:1030-1031 only has empty catalogue slots).
findings.root_cause: Guide produced ad hoc by prior sessions; N1 (no real source).
findings.fix: Report 3.4: content/ + tools/ layout, facts.json, Jinja templates with StrictUndefined, guide.html plus PDF, engine spike (WeasyPrint default, Chromium/Playwright fallback), SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH reproducibility, versioned file names, CI order facts > parity > build > pdf_lint > veraPDF > link check.
findings.acceptance_test: From a clean clone npm run docs produces dist/guide.html and dist/user-guide.pdf; second run identical (text layer or bytes); removing a manifest tool breaks the build; footer shows release version and date.
findings.correction: No generator found (re-searched all of Downloads, unlimited depth, for reportlab/SimpleDocTemplate/pdfkit/jsPDF/fpdf/'user-guide.pdf'); ReportLab 5.0.1 and pdfdoc.py:1030-1031 verified. Corrections: Downloads has 7 distinct guide page counts (46, 45, 44, 43, 6, 3, 2) across dozens of copies, not six; WeasyPrint PDF/UA-1 landed in v57 (Sept 2022) and is documented as experimental/not guaranteed valid (not '2025'); WeasyPrint needs Pango only, not Cairo; Playwright tagged/outline options exist since v1.42. Keep the veraPDF gate.

findings.title: Guide layout, pagination, type size and contrast
findings.evidence: pdf_lint.py on deploy/user-guide.pdf: body fill 97.7/16.9/99.8/5.0/93.3/40.5 %; 'TOOLBAR TOOLS' heading orphaned at foot of p1; group headers 1.25:1 contrast at 8.7 pt; 95 % of 7,765 characters under 10 pt (smallest 8 pt); dark full-bleed pages; symbols from non-embedded Symbol font.
findings.root_cause: Probable oversized unsplittable block (about one page tall) and headings without keep-with-next (inferred; no source).
findings.fix: Spec in report 3.5: break-after avoid on headings, splittable tables, print theme with optional dark edition, body 10.5-11 pt, contrast-checked palette, real Unicode glyphs, linked footer with version/date/Page N of M, contents page, Letter and A4.
findings.acceptance_test: pdf_lint --strict layout gates green: no page under 55 % except last, 0 orphan headings, 0 spans under 4.5:1, no text under 9 pt, 90 % of characters at 10 pt or more; proof print.
findings.correction: pdf_lint re-run reproduces fills 97.7/16.9/99.8/5.0/93.3/40.5, orphan 'TOOLBAR TOOLS' heading, 1.25:1 (my calc 1.26:1) group headers, 94.9% of 7,765 chars under 10 pt, smallest 8.0 pt. Root cause correctly labelled inferred.

findings.title: Accessible tagged PDF, metadata, bookmarks and links; serve the guide inline
findings.evidence: Deployed PDF has no /Lang, /MarkInfo, /StructTreeRoot, outline or DisplayDocTitle; 0 link annotations; 4 fonts not embedded (Helvetica, Helvetica-Bold, Helvetica-Oblique, Symbol); metadata '(anonymous)'/'(unspecified)'; netlify.toml:201-204 forces attachment and bundle.pretty.js:113116 sets download.
findings.root_cause: ReportLab output without a tag tree; no HTML alternative.
findings.fix: Report 3.6 property table: PDF/UA-1 via WeasyPrint or Chromium tagged output, embed Spectral and Inter (OFL), XMP, outline from headings, links, figure alt text, tables with TH scope; publish guide.html at /guide; serve PDF inline and remove the download attribute and the toolbar 'Download Website Tutorial PDF' link.
findings.acceptance_test: veraPDF --flavour ua1: 0 failed rules; Acrobat Accessibility Check and PAC 2024 pass; NVDA reads headings, tables and links in order; title bar shows document title; opens in-tab on iOS and Android.
findings.metric_or_grade_moved: Accessibility (documents); WCAG 2.2 AA for the guide; G1 closed
findings.correction: Catalogue lacks /Lang, /MarkInfo, /StructTreeRoot, outline; 0 links; 4 unembedded fonts; metadata anonymous; live Content-Disposition attachment (netlify.toml:201-204) and download attribute at bundle:113116. verification_summary: Verification of the docs-copy report. Most of it holds up: I re-opened every cited line in DEPLOY_DIR and bundle.pretty.js, re-ran the data probes, re-ran pdf_lint.py, curl-checked the live site, and fetched the NPS tour page plus publisher/docs references. Line numbers, counts and PDF measurements reproduce almost exactly. There are three factual errors, one blind spot and several fix-design risks. (1) The report's 45,928 is not the dashboard or Living Ledger total. Both sum engagement_periods, giving 46,163 (23,138 Union + 23,025 Confederate). 45,928 is only the sum of the total_casualties summary fields. Also, 'roughly 165,000' soldiers in find-ancestor.html is correct (NPS 93,921 + 71,699), so the proposed change to 'about 163,000' would introduce an error. (2) The report says Walkthrough stop 16 has no NPS video and proposes '15 also link to a video'. All 16 stops have one, confirmed in bundle.pretty.js:104100-104420 and on the NPS page. (3) The report's Historian sub-finding overlooks that all 137 chronology answers in historian.html:113-125 render the literal word 'undefined', because the code reads e.title/e.description but the data field is `event`. Fix-design risks: the normaliser sketch would corrupt proper nouns via sentence-casing and break typed-apostrophe searches; deleting the U-14BK alias leaves a dangling id in union_oob_brigades.json; and the drafted embed snippet uses the wrong URL parameter and names the wrong story. The report also missed a live development-diary page (unit-rendering-reference.html) and a broken rank-abbreviation function. Effort estimates for the manifest and lint work (docs-copy-16 and docs-copy-26) assume source code that does not exist. I appended a '## Verification' section (33-row verdict table, 8 missed issues) to docs-copy.md and changed nothing else.

Node simulation of the page's own code: 137 of 137 rendered answers read 'Day 1, 5:00am - Gettysburg environs: undefined'; search text is only the location string.

Land this before any Historian expansion and before the docs-copy-03 wording is applied.
